Name: Alex's Bedroom
Author: lemonade17
Description:
One of the things people seem to hate about marrying Alex is his awful bedroom (especially the wallpaper), so I decided to try my hand at making a mod.

TO INSTALL: simply download the .xnb file and replace 'spouserooms.xnb' in the Contents\Maps folder.

Downloads.Description: Replace the 'spouserooms.xnb' file in your Content\Maps folder with this file.

Mods.ManifestParseErrorText: it's not a SMAPI mod (see https://smapi.io/xnb for info).
